hypothesis: Extract a task-agnostic alphabet of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments plus fixed corpus-frequency and compatibility heuristics from the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each objective with a fresh global Ant System trail table. Seed start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop trails with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored molecules; have independent disposable ants construct variable-length molecular graphs from an empty state by sampling each compatible action in proportion to its task-local pheromone times the fixed heuristic; and, after every observe message, globally evaporate pheromone and let every accepted ant deposit score-rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the construction components it used, so oracle feedback stigmergically redirects later de novo construction without a surrogate or persistent ant state.
method_thesis: Extract a task-agnostic action alphabet of sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and compatible attachment statistics from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining no whole corpus molecule as a candidate. In each independent objective session, initialize a fresh Ant System pheromone table over start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop decisions, and seed it with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored starting molecules. For every evaluator-announced batch, independent ants begin from an empty graph and repeatedly sample valence-compatible construction actions with probability proportional to task-local pheromone times the fixed corpus-frequency heuristic, producing variable-length molecular graphs that are canonicalized and locally resampled until the returned batch is novel, valid, and unique. After oracle feedback, evaporate the global trail table and let every accepted construction deposit rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the components it used. This score-driven stigmergic memory recombines useful fragment transitions into fresh molecules without fitting a surrogate, retrieving or ranking a finite molecular pool, or enumerating a fixed candidate set. Trail statistics are mechanism evidence only; success is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus yields a sufficiently broad recurring alphabet of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, compatible transitions, and nonzero frequency heuristics for productive de novo construction.
Enough of the ten fixed molecules have deterministic traces in the prepared grammar to seed objective-specific start, attachment, and stop trails before the first adaptive colony.
Oracle scores vary enough within colonies for score ranks to induce meaningfully unequal positive deposits rather than an effectively uniform trail update.

High-scoring chemistry is reachable by variable-length recombination of fragments and compatible transitions in the fixed grammar, without requiring retrieval of intact corpus molecules or graph operations outside sequential attachment.

Shared component trails transfer useful terminal-score information across disposable ants within 29 adaptive colonies without early pheromone concentration eliminating the action diversity needed by a multimodal objective.

Compatibility masking, valence checks, stopping, sanitization, and local novelty filtering maintain enough terminal yield to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal and task-time limits.

The method may underperform when decisive fragments or attachment patterns are absent from the corpus grammar, when terminal rewards provide misleading component credit, or when globally shared trails favor locally useful components that combine poorly in new contexts.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the prepared attachment grammar cannot support exact valid reconstruction, if emitted molecules cannot be replayed from an empty graph through recorded compatible fragment actions, if accepted oracle scores do not produce the registered global evaporation and monotone rank-weighted deposits on exactly their used components, or if those deposits create no reproducible displacement from the evaporation-only action probabilities used by later ants.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to decompose only the unlabeled corpus into sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, collect feasible attachment-label transitions and start, transition, and stop frequencies, derive a fixed smoothed corpus heuristic and corpus-supported construction-length limits, verify deterministic held-out decompose-and-reassemble support, and publish only the fragment alphabet, compatibility data, heuristic, configuration, and support measurements rather than a whole-molecule candidate pool. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load the immutable prepared construction grammar, create a new objective-local pheromone table with positive uniform base trails, deterministically decompose representable fixed observations, and add score-rank-weighted initial deposits along their start, ordered attachment, and stop traces. For each suggestion, launch independent disposable ants from an empty graph; sample a start fragment and then compatible attachment or stop actions with probabilities proportional to current pheromone times the fixed corpus heuristic, enforce valence and a corpus-derived length bound, and retain the complete action and probability trace. Locally resample failed constructions and canonicalize and filter evaluated, previously emitted, and within-batch duplicate molecules until exactly the batch size announced by init is ready. Match every accepted observation once to its stored trace, apply one global evaporation to all feasible trails, add a positive rank-weighted deposit from every accepted ant to exactly its used start, attachment, and stop components, and use the resulting shared table for the next colony; do not fit a surrogate, retrieve or rank whole corpus molecules, enumerate a fixed molecular candidate set, preserve ant identities between batches, or update the fixed heuristic online.

Seed start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop trails with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored molecules; have independent disposable ants construct variable-length molecular graphs from an empty state by sampling each compatible action in proportion to its task-local pheromone times the fixed heuristic; and, after every observe message, globally evaporate pheromone and let every accepted ant deposit score-rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the construction components it used, so oracle feedback stigmergically redirects later de novo construction without a surrogate or persistent ant state.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, giving this batch-size-10 constructive optimizer only 29 feedback boundaries in which to assign sparse terminal scores to a large combinatorial space of fragment decisions; it must turn those scores into reusable shared construction bias without exhausting the budget on invalid, duplicate, or prematurely homogenized molecules.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the allowed unlabeled corpus supplies a recurring attachment grammar: this preparation found 57,739 usable decompositions, published 320 fragments, 46 compatibility pairs, and 3,395 positive-heuristic trails, and retained no whole-molecule candidate pool.

Supported for chemistry inside the published grammar's limited reach: exact replay succeeded on 31/320 held-out molecules, whereas 288 failed for unavailable fragments and one for the length bound. Transfer therefore requires the decisive fragments and sequential attachment route to be represented.

Supported when most fixed observations can seed the task-local table: 45/50 fixed observations across five sessions had deterministic exact traces, all 45 received positive rank-weighted deposits, and each session began with a fresh table.

Supported when within-batch oracle scores provide unequal ranks: all 145 feedback batches produced 9 or 10 distinct positive weights between 0.28 and 1.0, and every scored trace updated exactly its used trail components after global evaporation.

Supported when component-level terminal credit transfers across disposable ants: all 13,491 eligible decisions moved from the evaporation-only counterfactual with positive aggregate rewarded-action lift, and 1,355/1,450 emissions recombined deposited components from multiple earlier ants.

Operationally supported under batch size 10 and the 290-call adaptive horizon: all 145 colonies filled, all emissions replayed and sanitized, and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator despite 768 locally rejected attempts or completed collisions.

Applicability weakens when globally shared component credit is context-misleading or when accumulated unbounded trails eliminate diversity; the observed low final normalized entropies and task variation in recombination rate identify those as live limits rather than activation failures.
Conclusions are specific to seed 0 and this root implementation; multi-seed reliability and causal score benefit over an otherwise identical nonadaptive constructor remain unmeasured.

possible_failure_causes: Prepared grammar coverage was narrow: 288/320 held-out molecules required an unavailable fragment and one exceeded the construction-length limit, leaving exact reconstruction support at 0.096875. Objectives whose decisive structures fall outside the 320-fragment alphabet can therefore remain unreachable even though the supported grammar executes correctly.

Only 9/10 fixed observations were representable in each task-local grammar, so each initial table omitted one scored molecule because it had no available decomposition. A different starting set with fewer representable traces would provide less objective-specific pheromone before the first colony.

Novel-terminal efficiency was reduced mostly by 674 collisions with evaluated molecules; aggregate yield was 0.6537421100090172 per total ant attempt and the weakest colony yielded 0.24390243902439024. Stronger concentration or a less productive grammar could exhaust local attempts even though every current batch filled.

The final trail tables were concentrated: normalized entropy ranged from 0.30326063755775384 to 0.4106099197150958 across tasks and coefficient of variation from 14.95084526227372 to 23.158767630953857. Unbounded reinforcement may suppress useful alternatives later in longer or more deceptive searches.

Decision logs expose the chosen heuristic, pheromone, and probability and a digest of the full feasible candidate vector, but not every alternative candidate value verbatim. Source and deterministic digests support execution, while independent reconstruction of every normalized distribution from logs alone would require the prepared grammar artifact.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and a root with no Parent or ablation. It establishes activation, not multi-seed stability or the isolated terminal-score contribution of pheromone feedback over the same fixed fragment constructor.

Task-level recombination rates were 0.9655172413793104 on deco_hop, 0.9448275862068966 on drd2_docking, 0.9551724137931035 on median_2, 0.8551724137931035 on sitagliptin_mpo, and 0.9517241379310345 on zaleplon_mpo. Per colony, emitted sets used 8 to 38 unique fragments (mean 18.275862068965516) and 2 to 10 unique Bemis-Murcko scaffolds or canonical fallback structures (mean 6.303448275862069).

observable_measurements.value: Every one of 145/145 colonies emitted exactly the evaluator-announced ten unique canonical molecules, totaling 1,450 emissions; the evaluator accepted all 290 adaptive proposals on each task with validity 1.0 and duplicate rate 0.0. Aggregate yield was 1,450/2,142 completed constructions = 0.676937441643324 and 1,450/2,218 total ant attempts = 0.6537421100090172. Colony-level completed-construction and total-attempt yields each ranged from 0.24390243902439024 to 1.0. Rejection accounting was 65 no-compatible-action attempts, 11 construction-length exhaustions, 0 valence/attachment failures, 0 sanitization failures, 0 wrong-canonical reconstructions, 674 evaluated-molecule collisions, 0 separately classified previously-emitted collisions, and 18 within-batch collisions; these counts reconcile with attempts, completed constructions, and emissions.

possible_failure_causes: Prepared grammar coverage was narrow: 288/320 held-out molecules required an unavailable fragment and one exceeded the construction-length limit, leaving exact reconstruction support at 0.096875. Objectives whose decisive structures fall outside the 320-fragment alphabet can therefore remain unreachable even though the supported grammar executes correctly.

Only 9/10 fixed observations were representable in each task-local grammar, so each initial table omitted one scored molecule because it had no available decomposition. A different starting set with fewer representable traces would provide less objective-specific pheromone before the first colony.

Novel-terminal efficiency was reduced mostly by 674 collisions with evaluated molecules; aggregate yield was 0.6537421100090172 per total ant attempt and the weakest colony yielded 0.24390243902439024. Stronger concentration or a less productive grammar could exhaust local attempts even though every current batch filled.

The final trail tables were concentrated: normalized entropy ranged from 0.30326063755775384 to 0.4106099197150958 across tasks and coefficient of variation from 14.95084526227372 to 23.158767630953857. Unbounded reinforcement may suppress useful alternatives later in longer or more deceptive searches.

Decision logs expose the chosen heuristic, pheromone, and probability and a digest of the full feasible candidate vector, but not every alternative candidate value verbatim. Source and deterministic digests support execution, while independent reconstruction of every normalized distribution from logs alone would require the prepared grammar artifact.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and a root with no Parent or ablation. It establishes activation, not multi-seed stability or the isolated terminal-score contribution of pheromone feedback over the same fixed fragment constructor.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the allowed unlabeled corpus supplies a recurring attachment grammar: this preparation found 57,739 usable decompositions, published 320 fragments, 46 compatibility pairs, and 3,395 positive-heuristic trails, and retained no whole-molecule candidate pool.

Supported for chemistry inside the published grammar's limited reach: exact replay succeeded on 31/320 held-out molecules, whereas 288 failed for unavailable fragments and one for the length bound. Transfer therefore requires the decisive fragments and sequential attachment route to be represented.

Supported when most fixed observations can seed the task-local table: 45/50 fixed observations across five sessions had deterministic exact traces, all 45 received positive rank-weighted deposits, and each session began with a fresh table.

Supported when within-batch oracle scores provide unequal ranks: all 145 feedback batches produced 9 or 10 distinct positive weights between 0.28 and 1.0, and every scored trace updated exactly its used trail components after global evaporation.

Supported when component-level terminal credit transfers across disposable ants: all 13,491 eligible decisions moved from the evaporation-only counterfactual with positive aggregate rewarded-action lift, and 1,355/1,450 emissions recombined deposited components from multiple earlier ants.

Operationally supported under batch size 10 and the 290-call adaptive horizon: all 145 colonies filled, all emissions replayed and sanitized, and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator despite 768 locally rejected attempts or completed collisions.

Applicability weakens when globally shared component credit is context-misleading or when accumulated unbounded trails eliminate diversity; the observed low final normalized entropies and task variation in recombination rate identify those as live limits rather than activation failures.
Conclusions are specific to seed 0 and this root implementation; multi-seed reliability and causal score benefit over an otherwise identical nonadaptive constructor remain unmeasured.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus yields a sufficiently broad recurring alphabet of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, compatible transitions, and nonzero frequency heuristics for productive de novo construction.
Enough of the ten fixed molecules have deterministic traces in the prepared grammar to seed objective-specific start, attachment, and stop trails before the first adaptive colony.
Oracle scores vary enough within colonies for score ranks to induce meaningfully unequal positive deposits rather than an effectively uniform trail update.

High-scoring chemistry is reachable by variable-length recombination of fragments and compatible transitions in the fixed grammar, without requiring retrieval of intact corpus molecules or graph operations outside sequential attachment.

Shared component trails transfer useful terminal-score information across disposable ants within 29 adaptive colonies without early pheromone concentration eliminating the action diversity needed by a multimodal objective.

Compatibility masking, valence checks, stopping, sanitization, and local novelty filtering maintain enough terminal yield to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal and task-time limits.

The method may underperform when decisive fragments or attachment patterns are absent from the corpus grammar, when terminal rewards provide misleading component credit, or when globally shared trails favor locally useful components that combine poorly in new contexts.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the prepared attachment grammar cannot support exact valid reconstruction, if emitted molecules cannot be replayed from an empty graph through recorded compatible fragment actions, if accepted oracle scores do not produce the registered global evaporation and monotone rank-weighted deposits on exactly their used components, or if those deposits create no reproducible displacement from the evaporation-only action probabilities used by later ants.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to decompose only the unlabeled corpus into sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, collect feasible attachment-label transitions and start, transition, and stop frequencies, derive a fixed smoothed corpus heuristic and corpus-supported construction-length limits, verify deterministic held-out decompose-and-reassemble support, and publish only the fragment alphabet, compatibility data, heuristic, configuration, and support measurements rather than a whole-molecule candidate pool. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load the immutable prepared construction grammar, create a new objective-local pheromone table with positive uniform base trails, deterministically decompose representable fixed observations, and add score-rank-weighted initial deposits along their start, ordered attachment, and stop traces. For each suggestion, launch independent disposable ants from an empty graph; sample a start fragment and then compatible attachment or stop actions with probabilities proportional to current pheromone times the fixed corpus heuristic, enforce valence and a corpus-derived length bound, and retain the complete action and probability trace. Locally resample failed constructions and canonicalize and filter evaluated, previously emitted, and within-batch duplicate molecules until exactly the batch size announced by init is ready. Match every accepted observation once to its stored trace, apply one global evaporation to all feasible trails, add a positive rank-weighted deposit from every accepted ant to exactly its used start, attachment, and stop components, and use the resulting shared table for the next colony; do not fit a surrogate, retrieve or rank whole corpus molecules, enumerate a fixed molecular candidate set, preserve ant identities between batches, or update the fixed heuristic online.
research_intent.mechanism: Extract a task-agnostic alphabet of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments plus fixed corpus-frequency and compatibility heuristics from the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each objective with a fresh global Ant System trail table. Seed start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop trails with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored molecules; have independent disposable ants construct variable-length molecular graphs from an empty state by sampling each compatible action in proportion to its task-local pheromone times the fixed heuristic; and, after every observe message, globally evaporate pheromone and let every accepted ant deposit score-rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the construction components it used, so oracle feedback stigmergically redirects later de novo construction without a surrogate or persistent ant state.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, giving this batch-size-10 constructive optimizer only 29 feedback boundaries in which to assign sparse terminal scores to a large combinatorial space of fragment decisions; it must turn those scores into reusable shared construction bias without exhausting the budget on invalid, duplicate, or prematurely homogenized molecules.
